rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 8, 9 and 11: the prototype wins by default and only a DR1 judgement on the same difference overrides it; DR1 rule (b) (inc-161) judged exactly where return-to-overview controls go, when the design answered it both ways on adjacent pages, so it overrides the prototype's link-styled 'Save and return to overview' on these pages, while the amend-only 'Save and return' (to review) and secondary 'Save and continue' are a difference DR1 never judged, so the prototype default gives them.
outcome: While a notification is being amended, overview-linked pages get Design Release 2.1's full amend ending; the party pickers, the CPH number page and the permanent address page show 'Save and return' (primary, to the review page) and 'Save and continue' (secondary) only, without the link-styled 'Save and return to overview'. DR1 rule (b) is a judgement on where return-to-overview controls go, and the prototype itself answers that both ways in amend (the contact address page drops the hub button, the CPH page keeps it), the same split DR1 already ruled on, so rule (b) keeps the hub control off these pages; the review and continue buttons exist only in amend, DR1 never judged them, so the prototype default adds them. Outside amend these pages keep rule (b)'s primary button alone. Each position holds in part, so no claim is set aside whole.
